primary_objective: Drive qualified product-interest actions with useful education.
customer_problem: Rising utility costs and uncertainty during outages.
educational_message: Teach buyers how to match real device needs to verified power specs before purchasing.
core_message: Verified product details, practical use-case guidance, and one clear next step.
primary_cta: Get your free power readiness assessment
content_angles: Fear-to-control: outage anxiety to preparedness confidence
Spec-to-outcome: watt-hours translated to daily peace of mind
approved_claims: Use only verified product specs from structured product data.
Prefer phrasing like 'up to' and 'in many cases' for outcome language.
prohibited_claims: No fabricated customer testimonials or invented outcome numbers.
Do not claim guaranteed savings or guaranteed runtime.
Do not invent product capacity, wattage, or price.
